title: Theorem 8.3.7: semicontinuity of ‖δV‖ and of the density bound Θ^n ≥ 1 under varifold convergence
statement: Let V_i, V be n-varifolds on open U ⊆ ℝ^N with V_i → V as Radon measures on Gₙ(U) (RadonConverges), each V_i of locally bounded first variation with liminf_i ‖δV_i‖(W) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and sets B_i ⊆ ℝ^N with Θ^n(μ_{V_i}, y) existing and ≥ 1 for all y ∈ U ∖ B_i and μ_{V_i}(B_i ∩ W) → 0 for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Then V has locally bounded first variation, ‖δV‖(W) ≤ liminf_i ‖δV_i‖(W) for every open W ⊂⊂ U, and for μ_V-a.e. y, Θ^n(μ_V, y) exists and is ≥ 1. (Exactly DensitySemicontinuity.)
